title: task12_substitution_preflight
description: Verdict artifact emitted by tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/task12_substitution_preflight.py. Records the current friendly_l1.geomean_rel_err, per-cell contributions, candidate pool, simulated substitutions, and a fail-closed verdict indicating whether HARD-2 closure is mathematically feasible against the available levers.

hard_2_threshold.description: Frozen HARD-2 admission threshold per the plan; friendly_l1.geomean_rel_err must be strictly less than this for HARD-2 to PASS.

stddev_admission_gate.description: Frozen per-cell stddev admission gate per BL-20260504. Candidate cells must satisfy stddev <= this value to be admitted to the cohort.

substitution_assumed_rel_err.description: The conservative rel_err assumed for each hypothetical substitution candidate. The preflight uses this value as a worst-case ceiling so the feasibility verdict is conservative; actual candidate rel_err observed during live label collection may be lower.

current_geomean.description: The current friendly_l1.geomean_rel_err as reported by the diagnostic report sidecar (read from per_bucket_headline.friendly_l1.geomean_rel_err).

per_cell_contributions.description: Per-cell friendly_l1 contributions sorted by input order. Each entry's rel_err_l1 enters the geomean.

candidate_pool.description: Cells eligible to substitute INTO the friendly_l1 cohort during a future task12 round. Each entry records the cell's identity tuple + its L2 truth (proxy for collection health). The pool does NOT include cells in the current friendly_l1 cohort.

simulated_substitutions.description: Counterfactual substitution arms ordered by substitution_count ascending. Each arm removes the k worst-rel_err cells and replaces them with k hypothetical candidate cells (each at substitution_assumed_rel_err); the new geomean shows whether HARD-2 closes under that arm.

minimum_geomean_achievable.description: The minimum geomean across all simulated substitution arms. If this is >= hard_2_threshold, task12 cohort substitution cannot close HARD-2 under the given candidate pool + assumed rel_err.

hard_2_closure_feasible.description: True IFF at least one simulated substitution arm yields a new_friendly_l1_geomean strictly below hard_2_threshold.

verdict.description: Human-readable verdict token. Either task12_substitution_feasible_min_subs_<N> (feasible at N substitutions) OR task12_substitution_infeasible_pivot_to_l1_model_class (infeasible; pivot per the cohort-substitution review directive).

pivot_recommendation.description: Concrete next-round work pointer. On feasibility, names the live-collection prerequisite. On infeasibility, points at the alternative L1 model-class lever.
